title: Nightcord at 25:00 Chapter1 Episode1 Opening

rows.Line: I loved my mom's music box.

Mom's health wasn't great,
so dad gave it to her as a present.
He'd composed the song himself.

Dad's songs were always gentle and heartwarming.
Anyone who listened to them felt happy.

I wanted to become a composer like my dad.
To write songs that would make people happy.
But...
He won't compose another song ever again.

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line:
My songs hurt him.
It was my fault...

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: Dad only became like that because my songs don't make others happy.

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: So I must become a composer who can write songs that will bring happiness to someone.

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: I must compose... I must compose...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No...not like this.
This isn't the right sound.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
The subdivision is fine.
Maybe if I changed the chord substitution here...

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line:
<I just sent you the lyrics for the new song.
Can you take a look when you have some time?>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <K, you haven't slept, have you? You okay?>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line:
<Hehe. yeah, I guess.
You all work so hard, so I'm just trying to do my part as well.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <We may not know each other's faces or real names, but since we're composing together, I want to do my best too.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line:
<You're always up working late, though.
Take care of yourself, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Not until I can write a song that makes someone happy...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Hang on...what's this file? “Untitled”?
I don't remember composing this...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I thought I was in my room.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Kanade, this is SEKAI, another world.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Miku?
As in, the VIRTUAL SINGER, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I'm talking to Miku face-to-face?
Am I dreaming?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I've been waiting for you, Kanade.
In this SEKAI.
For the longest time.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. A lonely world born from her feelings.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm here to help her find her true feelings.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. When she finds her true feelings, they will give birth to a song.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But she won't find anything here by herself, in this lonely and empty SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You want me to help...but how?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You don't have to know right now.
You'll meet her in this SEKAI one day. I'm sure of it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
When you do, please help her.
She's so close... Closer than you think.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Hold on a minute...
I really have no idea what you're talking about.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I'm out of time.
It's up to you now, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's up to you to save her.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh. I fell asleep...and had this really strange dream.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Urgh...I can't remember it.
But I think I was working on the song before that, then Yuki...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Right. I was DM'ing with Yuki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
The timestamp's from a while ago...
I can't believe I slept for so long.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Am I getting enough sleep?
I guess I could take a nap...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Until I make a song...that can save someone.
